mapper.select: SELECT code AS unit_code, UPPER(TRIM(name)) AS form_value, TRIM(name) AS label FROM sys_status_codes WHERE category = #{category} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code ASC
SELECT code, UPPER(TRIM(name)) AS formValue, TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(description, ''), name)) AS label FROM sys_status_codes WHERE category = 'CALC_RULE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code ASC
SELECT code, UPPER(TRIM(name)) AS formValue, TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(description, ''), name)) AS label FROM sys_status_codes WHERE category = 'CALC_TYPE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code ASC

SELECT code, TRIM(name) AS name, TRIM(COALESCE(description, '')) AS description FROM sys_status_codes WHERE category = 'KPI_TYPE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND code IN (101, 102, 103) ORDER BY CASE code WHEN 102 THEN 1 WHEN 101 THEN 2 WHEN 103 THEN 3 ELSE code END
SELECT code, name, description FROM sys_status_codes WHERE category = 'CALC_RULE' AND code IN (801, 802, 803, 804) AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code
